tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search the pwamart catalog of installable web apps (PWAs). Returns name, slug, summary, publisher, rating, installs and the URL to open.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Full details of one app by slug: description, screenshots, installability checks, publisher and install instructions for every platform.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Collections of apps for agentic workflows (coding, payments, ops, growth, research, talking to humans; every MCP server, CLI or API). Each has one command that installs every CLI in it and one MCP config for every server.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: One collection's apps, with each app's surfaces (CLI install command, MCP endpoint, API base) and the collection's one-command installs.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category with how many apps it has.

tools.name: install_app
tools.description: How to install an app on a given platform, plus the URL to open. An agent with a shell can run the returned command; otherwise show the steps to the user.

tools.name: submit_app
tools.description: List a PWA: inspects the URL and creates a draft under one of your publishers. Needs PWAMART_API_KEY (Bearer pm_live_...).

tools.name: verify_app
tools.description: Check the domain-ownership token for a draft app. Needs an API key.

tools.name: fill_publisher
tools.description: Read a website and suggest a publisher name, logo and bio (from its manifest and page; the bio is written by AI only when the site has no description). Saves only when save is true. Needs an API key.

tools.name: verify_publisher
tools.description: Prove the publisher runs its website (manifest token, /.well-known file, meta tag or DNS TXT). Without the token in place, returns how to add it. Needs an API key.

tools.name: publish_app
tools.description: Publish a verified, installable app to the store. Needs an API key.

tools.name: feature_app
tools.description: Get a published app featured for $19: 7 days on the pwamart home page and a slot in the next newsletter. Returns a CoinPay crypto checkout URL for a human to pay; with credit: true it spends a free Featured week earned with karma instead (no payment). Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_badge
tools.description: The live "Get it on pwamart" badge (rating + installs) for a listing, as HTML and Markdown snippets to paste on the app's site, plus whether its homepage links back (the ✓ and a followed link). Pass slug, or site (a homepage URL) to find which listing a site is.

tools.name: check_badge
tools.description: Re-check the app's homepage for a link back to its pwamart listing now (the badge). Verified earns the ✓ and a followed link. Needs an API key for an app you publish.

tools.name: get_releases
tools.description: What's new in an app: its releases (published by the developer or detected from manifest changes), newest first.

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Get notified when an app updates, or when a publisher ships a new app or update. Needs an API key or `pwamart login` (or pass an email for a confirmation link).

tools.name: redeem_credit_code
tools.description: Redeem a pwamart credit code (PM-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) for days of the Pro plan, added after any time the account already has. Each code works once per account. Needs an API key or `pwamart login`.

tools.name: my_invites
tools.description: Your pwamart invites: how many are left, each one's state, how many were accepted, and your open ?ref= link. Needs an API key.

tools.name: create_invite
tools.description: Make a single-use pwamart invite link for a new account (3 per account, 30 days). When the invitee confirms their account, both of you get Pro days. The link is returned once. Needs an API key.

tools.name: my_karma
tools.description: Your pwamart karma: total, this week, rank, badges, free Featured week credits, karma to the next one, recent history and how to earn more. Needs an API key or `pwamart login`.

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: The public karma leaderboard: members ranked by karma earned upvoting, reviewing, commenting on, sharing and publishing apps. Falls back to all time when the period is empty.

tools.name: upvote_app
tools.description: Upvote an app (one per member per app; earns +1 karma, +1 to its owner, not on your own apps). remove: true takes the vote back. Needs an API key.

tools.name: review_app
tools.description: Rate an app 1 to 5 with an optional review (30+ characters earns 5 karma, once per app, not your own). Posting again updates your review. Needs an API key.

tools.name: comment
tools.description: Comment on an app's page, or reply to a comment (parent = its id; one level). 10+ characters earns 2 karma (up to 10 a day). Rate limited. Needs an API key.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: An app's comments with their replies, each author's name and karma.

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to the pwamart newsletter. A confirmation email is sent; nothing else is until it is tapped.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_app" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List a PWA: inspects the URL and creates a draft under one of your publishers. Needs PWAMART_API_KEY (Bearer pm_live_...).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_apps, install_app, submit_app, feature_app, get_badge, follow, list_comments · Private data: verify_app, fill_publisher, verify_publisher, publish_app, feature_app, check_badge, follow, redeem_credit_code, my_invites, create_invite, my_karma, upvote_app, review_app, comment · Public sink: submit_app, publish_app, check_badge, follow, subscribe_newsletter · Destructive: install_app, upvote_app.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_apps, install_app, submit_app, feature_app, get_badge, follow, list_comments · Private data: verify_app, fill_publisher, verify_publisher, publish_app, feature_app, check_badge, follow, redeem_credit_code, my_invites, create_invite, my_karma, upvote_app, review_app, comment · Public sink: submit_app, publish_app, check_badge, follow, subscribe_newsletter · Destructive: install_app, upvote_app

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
